---
title: Publish your app
description: Use Publish in the top bar to push the current draft live.
sidebar:
  order: 12
---

The publish control is on the right of the project top bar. When idle, click **Publish** (the label can change to **Publishing**, **Republish**, and similar).

While publishing, the control describes progress in plain language, such as **Checking your project**, **Building**, **Updating data**, and **Going live**. When it finishes, other people can open that version at the published URL.

Notes:

- While chat is still **Building**, publish is blocked — the draft is still changing. Wait for the turn to finish.
- To see release history: Console → PUBLISH → **Production** → **History** (when publish is available for the project).
- To roll back, expand the target version in **History** and click **Roll back to this version**.
- To take a live app offline, open the Publish panel and click **Unpublish**. **Rolling back…** in the top bar is a progress label only.
